proposals.title: Near-black radial stage behind a scene
proposals.why: 6 of 8 references start from a solid with a centred Radial Ramp, near-black (DJ1 #050505→#000, DJ5 #090909→#020202, DJ2 #0a0a0a→#050505), often Scatter 50 against banding; DJ4 tints it blue, drag-drop/ig1 use slate.
proposals.overlaps: background (same job, different look): better as a `look` option + STYLE knobs than a new primitive. Note: Scatter is seeded per layer, so rebuilds differ by ±2/255 (see DJ5).
proposals.from: references/dj1-trial-rings.recipe.json, references/dj2-trial-toggle.recipe.json, references/dj4-tilted-stats.recipe.json, references/dj5-card-variants.recipe.json, references/drag-drop.recipe.json, references/ig1.recipe.json

proposals.title: Number that counts up from a CTRL slider
proposals.why: DJ1 ("%" from Progress), DJ3 (Views (M) .toFixed(1)+"M"), DJ4 (Progress×190 +"K", stepped at 12 fps) all drive a text layer's Source Text from one keyframed CTRL slider with a suffix.
proposals.call: countUp(textLayer, {from, to, at, duration, decimals, suffix, steps})
proposals.overlaps: none in the kit; the CTRL-slider driver is shared with ringStat

proposals.title: Progress ring (base + fill) with a counter in the middle
proposals.why: DJ1 (two rings, followers vs non-followers) and DJ4 (169K, 100% non-followers) both build Ring Base + Ring Fill shapes whose trim end is CTRL Progress×100, Deep Glow on the fill, a count and a label inside.
proposals.call: ringStat(comp, {value, label, color, at, duration, size, x, y})
proposals.overlaps: would use countUp for the number and pop for the entrance

proposals.title: Cursor that travels to a target and clicks
proposals.why: DJ1 (cursor clicks Post), DJ2 (Tap on the Post button), drag-drop (hand grabs and drops icons, Grab/Grabbed swap) and YouTube (cursor to the description link) all animate a vector cursor precomp along a path with a press dip at the target.
proposals.call: cursorClick(comp, {to: layer|[x, y], from, at, travel, press: true, drag: layer})
proposals.overlaps: none; the cursor art lives in the Motion Library (Cursor, Grab/Grabbed)

proposals.title: Deep Glow on accent shapes and numbers
proposals.why: DJ1 (12 Deep Glows), DJ3, DJ4 and DJ5 put the same Deep Glow (Radius 150, Exposure ~0.02) on rings, arrows, stamps and counters so accents bloom on the dark stage.
proposals.overlaps: a STYLE.glow knob that pop/countUp/ringStat could apply, rather than its own primitive

proposals.title: CTRL null + camera that slowly pushes and drifts
proposals.why: DJ2 and DJ3 (CAM CTRL null), DJ4 (Camera 50mm) and YouTube (MOVE nulls: page + scale) all move the whole scene through one rig instead of animating layers, giving the slow push/tilt that makes the UI feel 3D.

proposals.title: Light sweep across a card
proposals.why: DJ3 (arrow/card) and DJ4 use CC Light Sweep (Width 50, Sweep 50, Edge 100) to catch the eye on a stat card. DJ3 drives its direction with wiggle(), which is why its rebuild isn't exact; a primitive should key the sweep instead.

proposals.title: Phone frame with a UI screen inside
proposals.why: DJ3 (Phone shape under the views card) and ig1 (editable phone assembly with status bar, Instagram profile, scrolling matte) both put a card over a phone screen.
proposals.overlaps: a scene more than a primitive; ig1 already is that scene
